project_info.tagline: Italian Ceramic Craftsmanship & Architectural Profiles Since 1976
primary_collections: Moon Spots (9x60cm retractable cut ceramic modules)

theme.rationale: Ceramic and architectural materials are best represented in warm natural light, travertine tones, and stone textures with airy whitespace.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-stone-500

typography.pairing_archetype: The Editorial Architect (High-end Italian Design Studio)

rules: Never use pure black #000000; use warm charcoal #1C1917
Primary CTA buttons must use accent_terracotta (#C05A3E) or dark_surface (#1C1917)
Containers with borders must have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision
Text over images must use gradient overlays (e.g. from-black/60 via-black/30 to-transparent) or semi-transparent cards

grids_and_layout.strategy: Swiss Architectural Bento Grid + Editorial Spacing
grids_and_layout.header: Sticky glassmorphism navigation (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200/60 z-50)
grids_and_layout.hero_section: Asymmetric 2-column or full-screen architectural layout with high-impact product close-ups and sub-brand 'fittile_' accent tag

image_urls.usage: Main shop hero section, architectural tile context
Stony Collection banner and product detail page showcase
Traditional Terracotta and modern skirting integration
Sample swatch request section & material close-up

key_components_to_build.name: Header & Navigation Bar
key_components_to_build.details: Brand logo 'Ceramica Incontro' + 'fittile_' badge, categories dropdown (Battiscopa, SMUSSO, Moon Spots, Paper Glass, Stony), currency selector (EUR), Search bar, Cart Drawer trigger with item count badge, User Account / Login trigger.

key_components_to_build.name: Product Catalog & Filters
key_components_to_build.details: Grid display with view switcher (Grid/List), filters by Collection, Finish (Matt/Polished), Format (33cm, 45cm, 60cm, 9x60cm, 8x33cm), Color, Price, and Usage (Wall/Floor/Skirting). Square/m² price calculator included.

key_components_to_build.name: Product Detail Page (PDP)
key_components_to_build.details: High-res gallery with zoom, technical specs sheet (thickness, box coverage m²/linear meters, anti-slip rating), m² and box coverage calculator, sample request modal, add to cart button, shipping estimator based on weight/pallets.

key_components_to_build.name: Shopping Cart & Slide-Over Drawer
key_components_to_build.details: Real-time weight and pallet calculation, shipping cost breakdown based on weight/destination (Italy/EU), free sample indicator, direct Stripe checkout trigger.

key_components_to_build.name: Stripe & Express Checkout Flow
key_components_to_build.details: Multi-step or accordion checkout: Customer Info / Auth, Delivery Address (with VAT/Codice Fiscale for Italian invoicing), Shipping Option selection (Standard Freight, Express Courier, Pallet Express, Factory Pickup in Sassuolo), Stripe Payment Element.

key_components_to_build.name: Customer Account & Order History
key_components_to_build.details: Orders list, downloadable PDF invoices, shipment tracking status, saved shipping/billing addresses, quote requests for architectural projects.

key_components_to_build.name: Admin Panel (Management)
key_components_to_build.details: Dashboard for product CRUD, inventory control (boxes/m²), order fulfillment status update, shipping rules & weight rates setup, customer VAT management.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the workspace.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards include explicit data-testid attributes according to testing conventions.
Implement full mock or real integration for Stripe payment checkout.
Maintain high aesthetic standards: generous whitespace, elegant serif titles, subtle stone/terracotta accents, crisp 1px borders.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed headers without appropriate background fill or heavy backdrop-blur.
